metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2026 · Michael
metas.description: The early life of musician Michael Jackson, from the discovery of his talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to the artist whose creative ambition fueled a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · Hamnet
metas.description: In late 16th-century England, Agnes, a healer sensitive to the world around her, builds a home with William, a local tutor and aspiring playwright. As their lives fracture, they are tested by distance, silence, and grief.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Nuremberg
metas.description: A WWII psychiatrist evaluates Nazi leaders before the Nuremberg trials, growing increasingly obsessed with understanding evil as he forms a disturbing bond with Hermann Göring.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2025 · Roofman
metas.description: A charismatic criminal, while on the run from the police, hides in a hidden space of a toy store. There, he adopts a new identity and becomes involved with an employee, beginning a relationship as unlikely as it is risky.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · The Smashing Machine
metas.description: The story of mixed-martial arts and UFC champion, Mark Kerr.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · The Lost Bus
metas.description: A wayward school bus driver and a dedicated school teacher battle to save 22 children from a terrifying inferno.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2025 · Song Sung Blue
metas.description: Lightning and Thunder, a Milwaukee husband and wife Neil Diamond tribute act, experience soaring success and devastating heartbreak in their musical journey together.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Springsteen: Deliver Me from Nowhere
metas.description: Bruce Springsteen's journey crafting his 1982 album Nebraska, which emerged as he recorded Born in the USA with the E Street Band. Based on Warren Zanes' book.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Unabomber
metas.description: A Harvard student becomes the Unabomber after psychological experiments. Years later, an FBI agent's pursuit reveals how his past shaped his deadly campaign that killed 3 and injured 23 from 1978-1995.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2025 · Ikkis
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of the 1971 war, follows the life of second Lieutenant Arun Khetrapal.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · Blue Moon
metas.description: Tells the story of Lorenz Hart's struggles with alcoholism and mental health as he tries to save face during the opening of "Oklahoma!".
